rulings.why: Raises the character's own death threshold permanently; dyingThresholdBonus is a real field (diehard, spark-of-immortality, soul-well carry 1) and spirit-of-vigil carries nothing and is in no registry.

d4->d6 plus the parry trait on a Strike the character already has is exactly unarmedTraits; intercepting-hand is the registered match:['fist'] precedent and derive.ts applyUnarmedRiders reads the field.

needsEngineWork stands after checking the lane: FeatChoiceDef kind 'domains' resolves strictly from content.deities[deityId].domains in Builder.tsx (both the direct and the grantedFeatChoice picker), so no record field can add an off-list domain or re-point another feat's picker at a replacement set.

A real defensive resistance the player gains, and the mode lane already ships the identical triggered one-effect shape (adept-benefit-amulet: feat-gated, duration 'until the start of your next turn', resistance with an @actor formula).

MISS is right but the lane EXISTS: FEAT_SITUATIONAL carries dcOnly save stars for exactly this (duchy-defender 'resisting attempts to Disarm you of the duchy defender', sixfingers-elixir), and avoid-fates-gaze/become-shadow already express 'roll at mythic proficiency' as the bonus. Only the per-item Hardness/HP half has no home.

situational.when: against attempts to Disarm, Steal or otherwise remove your warshard weapon

rulings.why: A player-side exemption from a rule the app really does surface (padded-armor and ouroboros-buckles both print the sleep-in-armor fatigue), and RECORD_MARKERS is the condition-mark lane (ever-dreaming carries the sibling sleep entry). No entry for this id.
ironhoof-centaur grants Hoof at d6, so stepDie:true lands the printed 1d8 exactly; match:['hoof'] hits that strike name and the record carries nothing.

Treat Wounds is a real action record in core.actions and RECORD_MARKERS already carries a treat-wounds mark (magic-hands), so a capability change to the player's own action has a home and this id has none.

A flat check the PLAYER rolls against a DC the persistent-damage condition record prints as 15; the condition-mark lane already carries DC overrides of this shape (choker-of-elocution, defy-death) and the id is in no registry.
Separate reachable record for the Stonebound archetype with the identical player-side bleed-DC and drained-recovery text; carries nothing, in no registry, so it needs its own mark.
Extra damage the player deals, gated on the target's category — the strikeDamage star is the registered shape for exactly that (between-the-scales, duchy-defender) and no entry exists.

A real climb Speed, correctly put behind a gate rather than a bare speeds field; feat-gated speed modes already ship (canopy-predator climb 15, axe-climber, cyclonic-ascent) and no anadi shape mode exists to hang it on.
A skill substitution on an action record that exists (gather-information), which is precisely the fancy-moves shape already in RECORD_MARKERS; recall-knowledge also exists and the id has no entry.

needsEngineWork stands: types.ts has no rangeIncrement/range field on any record type and nothing in src/rules reads one off a feat, so the range number the strike card prints cannot be moved by data.

A flat check the player rolls to refuse a condition outright — the fatigued condition record is real and the marker lane carries the same negate-a-condition shape (evade-doom on doomed). No entry for this id.
Degree-of-success shifts on the player's own checks; recall-knowledge and decipher-writing are both real action records and experienced-professional is the registered 'crit fail -> fail' precedent.

needsEngineWork stands: grantsFeats is unconditional and FEAT_FEAT_GRANTS_LEVELED gates only on character LEVEL, so neither can express 'as soon as you meet the prerequisites' (trained/master in Athletics) — writing it would hand a 2nd-level monk the 7th-level Water Sprint.
The player's own Grapple check turns a critical failure into a failure — a degree-of-success change on a real action record, the experienced-professional shape, and no entry exists.
A real extra daily use, and the marker is the only lane: usesUpgrade retunes a FEAT's limitedUses and drain-bonded-item is an action record with no limitedUses at all, so no pool exists to retune.

Permanent quickened is a standing state and RECORD_MARKERS already carries five identical {on:'condition',id:'quickened',value:'always on'} entries (eternal-boost, eternal-composition, full-automation, panache-paragon, perfect-readiness); this id has none.
Success->critical success on the player's own Balance and Climb checks plus the off-guard waiver; both action records exist and the degree-of-success mark is a registered shape.
A defensive rule about the player's own AC under a condition the app tracks; the clumsy condition record is real and the marker lane already carries condition-value overrides (the-fool on stupefied).
Extra damage the player's own spell deals, gated on raging and drained 2+ — correctly a spellDamage star rather than a flat field, and the id is in no registry.

The feat's entire content is a 2-action ACTIVITY the companion performs at the table (two tail Strikes, MAP, forced movement) — no companion statistic changes, and COMPANION_MODS models senses/HP/speeds/IWR/maturity/skills, not action lists. The same judge ruled stitched-familiar ('grants an activity to your familiar') NEEDS_NOTHING in this very file.
MISS is right and the judge named the lane itself: RECORD_MARKERS carries the identical permanent-quickened entries, so this is data, not engine work. Only the ally-aura half stays unmodelled.

situational.note: Swift Paragon: you're permanently quickened; the extra action can be used only to Step, Stride, or Fly (if you have a fly Speed). If you're mounted on your animal companion at the start of your turn, you can have the mount be quickened that turn instead of you.

rulings.why: MISS is right and the lane exists: RECORD_MARKERS holds action-rule changes of exactly this shape (feather-step 'you can Step into difficult terrain', quick-unlock, quick-refugee's sneak mark) and core.actions.sneak is a real record.

situational.note: Swift Sneak: you move your full Speed when you Sneak, and you can Sneak while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have that movement type.

rulings.why: A flat precision-damage rider the player deals, capped to the first hit each round with one weapon — the strikeDamage star is the registered shape and nothing carries it.
The spell ships in core.spells and every sibling composition feat (hymn-of-healing, song-of-strength, silvers-refrain) carries focusSpells with its own id; without it the bard learns nothing.
A permanent die step and trait on a Strike the witch already has; demons-hair is the registered match:['hair'] + stepDie twin and this record carries nothing.
Adds reach to an existing unarmed Strike, which is the field's stated purpose (effortless-reach is the registered add:['reach'] case); the hex-delivery half correctly stays out.
build.ts sums preparedTacticsBonus off every taken feat into preparedMax, so the +1 lands for real; efficient-preparation is the only current carrier and this feat is missing it.
needsEngineWork stands: commanderFolioMax(level) is a closed formula (5 +2 at 7/15/19) and build.ts slices the folio to it with no feat term, so no record field can add the two tactics.

Word-for-word the fighter twin of divine-reflexes ('At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction…'), which judge-10 ruled NEEDS_NOTHING and no adversary contested; the settled line is that permanent QUICKENED is a condition mark because core.conditions.quickened exists, while per-turn REACTION economy is not modelled and has no condition to mark.

The stratagem half is real and athletic-strategist is the registered twin, but the second star must go: the app never applies the -2 for a nonlethal attack (only the trait glossary mentions it), and judge-36 refused stage-fighting for that exact reason — a star for a penalty that is never applied is a phantom bonus.

situational.when: attack stratagem with a one-handed club-group weapon
situational.bonus: use Int on the attack roll; the Strike qualifies for strategic strike

rulings.why: MISS is right but the lane exists and its own sibling already uses it: scroll-esoterica ships a daily, recorded-only FeatChoiceDef for the same 'two temporary items at daily preparations' text. Item creation itself stays out, exactly as the scroll entry says.

choice.prompt: Today's two temporary talismans (item level up to half your level)
choice.inert: Recorded only — the temporary talismans aren't added to your inventory.
choice.note: Each talisman's item level must be no higher than half your level, and you must know its formula; you know every common talisman formula in GM Core of your level or lower, and need no formula book for them. They lose their magic at your next daily preparations.

rulings.why: needsEngineWork stands: attachKind()/the host rule in src/rules/attachments.ts caps a host at one talisman and no field nominates an exempt item, so the engine actively contradicts the feat.

Gap real, lane wrong — the same call as lightning-rings-intervention/overcharge: COMPANION_MODS is consumed only where mod.kinds includes 'animal' (companions.ts:344/355/427/465) or 'eidolon' (784); deriveFamiliar reads cfg.abilities and CompanionGrant.lockedAbilities only, so kinds:['familiar'] passes the applier's kind check and then sits dead. What is missing is a feat-to-familiar-ability lane for path-of-the-tempest, which is a real core.familiarAbilities entry.
draconic-aspect grants the Jaws Strike, so match:['jaws'] + add:['grapple'] lands the printed trait on an attack that already exists; no stepDie, no over-grant, and the record carries nothing.

The remaster tengu-weapon-familiarity record carries this exact critSpec + critSpecWeapons pair, so the legacy feat is verifiably inert; critSpec is properly scoped by critSpecWeapons, so no over-grant.

needsEngineWork stands: every modelled resistance value is a number or an @actor formula, and this one keys off the ATTACKER's frightened value — a flat number would be a large over-grant and a prose value would not evaluate.

A 1-minute dismissable self-buff with a standing resistance is the mode lane's definition; 'all-damage' is the resistance type string the corpus already uses (unstoppable-juggernaut, ghostly-resistance) and the mode is feat-gated, so it is opt-in and cannot over-grant.
